column1: # Only unambiguous misspellings. Words that are valid English on their own
# are deliberately excluded even when they are usually typos:
#   its / it's   — both valid, needs context (Tier 2)
#   lets / let's — "he lets me" is valid
#   wont / won't — "wont" is a real (if rare) word
# --- transpositions in the most common words ---------------------------
# NOTE: "teh" sengaja TIDAK ada di sini. Meski di Inggris itu typo "the",
# dalam Bahasa Indonesia "teh" adalah kata sah (minuman) dengan frekuensi
